blind.B1: No. GSE273694 is gastrocnemius RNA-seq from male PanK4 WT (n=8) and muscle-specific KO (n=6) mice, 28 weeks, glucose-injected 40 min before euthanasia (S4.1.1.4.p1, S11.p1). No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor; the paper's exercise data are human phosphoproteomics/Western (Fig 1A-C) and mouse treadmill/contraction experiments (S4.1.4), not transcriptomics.
blind.B2: Only PanK4 mKO vs WT, WT n=8, mKO n=6 (Fig 1E uses n=8 WT; Fig 2-4 legends n=8/6). Used for the BCAA-catabolism gene check (S2.6.p5, Fig S9A-C).
blind.B3: None. One gastrocnemius per mouse; candidate pairing keys in packet A link 0/14 samples.
blind.B4: Paper says only 'Differentially gene expression was calculated using DESeq2 (V1.34.0)' (S4.1.1.4.p1); one two-group comparison, joint-vs-pairwise not applicable.
blind.B5: No rule stated: no FDR/p cutoff or fold-change cutoff given, no DEG count; only 'no significant alterations in genes encoding enzymes related to BCAA catabolism' (S2.6.p5).

checks.evidence: S4.1.1.4.p1, packet A: treatment constant across 14 samples, genotype only factor, no exercise arm. The refusal_vs_exercise_words flag fires only on contact_department (lab name), a false positive.
No contrast run; WT 8 / mKO 6 recorded matches paper n.
repeated_measure_unit none; one muscle per mouse; packet A keys link 0/14.
No execution; paper states DESeq2 only.
No execution; single sex, same tissue and treatment.
Integer prepDE.py counts (integer_fraction 1.0); paper's FPKM wording recorded as discrepancy, executable_without_change.
Paper states no threshold (S4.1.1.4.p1, S2.6.p5); record says not stated.
HANDBACK claims no DEG counts, consistent with paper giving none.
Claim 'no exercise arm' is true and established by metadata plus paper methods, not a narrow search; contact_department hit is not an exercise factor.

summary: GSE273694 只有 PanK4 WT 与肌肉特异性 KO 的腓肠肌 RNA-seq(8 对 6),全部为空腹后注射葡萄糖,没有运动组,拒绝运行的理由成立。机械标记 refusal_vs_exercise_words 只是实验室部门名称,属误报。论文未给阈值和 DEG 数,记录一致。
